ChangeNotes.Value:
v3.4.0 - their voices move to a free app you install without leaving the game, and they now direct how every line of theirs sounds.
VOICES, REBUILT AROUND CLAUDE-VOICE * The voices now come from claude-voice, a free app installed right from the Voices page (talk screen, O) - no window, no terminal. Voices stay off until you turn them on. * Three engines, each with a sample to hear first: Breeze laughs and whispers (English, NVIDIA 16 GB), Qwen reads every language (NVIDIA 4 GB), Pocket runs on any PC. The page reads your graphics card and marks the one that suits it. * The Voices button is red, amber or green: not set up, working on it, ready. * The install shows every step - what is downloading, how fast, how long is left - while you keep playing. Quit mid-install and it carries on; stop it and nothing is lost. * Pick which drive keeps the voice files; every drive shows its free space. * Had the old built-in voices? The Qwen model you already have is reused, never downloaded twice. * Characters direct their own voice: every reply ends with how it should sound, shown small in orange under their words - and on Breeze they laugh and sigh. * "Engines & storage": switch engines, add one, see every folder and its size. Remove the voice app and everything it downloaded with one confirm. * The voice app gives the graphics card back when you leave the game. * Sibylla's voice leaves the mod - it was Abby's all along, and Abby comes with the voice app, beside a new voice, Neya. * Hosted voices (the OpenAI key) are retired - Pocket covers the no-graphics-card case for free.
NEW WAYS TO PLAY * Already pay for ChatGPT? Choose Codex in the options and your plan carries the NPCs - no API key. * Mute NPC, on the talk screen: that person stops coming to you and writing first, but still answers you. No penalty, kept in your save.
CHANGED * Characters no longer invent a private backstory at your first meeting - the starting personality is off unless you switch it on. * The download carries no program any more.
